label: mid copy phase, token-specific (out z/j/k/e/b/1 or input z/m/s/q/w/l/0)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (essentially 0 in original/delimiter phases), concentrated at recall positions 3-5 (rate ~25% at recall_idx 3-4) and rarely on the final output step or at recall_idx<=1. Within that window it is strongly token-selective: output token z (44% rate, 8x lift), j, k, e, b, 1, and to a lesser degree when the input (previously copied token) is z, m, s, q, w, l or 0. Strongest activations occur on runs like ...m z z... where z is being output around recall_idx 3-4; typically 1-3 consecutive copy steps are active. Phase/position alone gives high recall but precision ~0.19-0.23; the token lists raise F1 to ~0.56 but the token selectivity is graded rather than a clean set, so the description is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: z, j, k, b, e, 1; least: -, x, i, d) and the current input token, by step (t=13: z, s, m, q; t=7: z, s, m, w; t=9: z, w, m, s); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, phase=2.
